VBO:0200363.summary: Chukotka Sled Dogs learn quickly and retain the skills needed for long journeys, with endurance central to their working character. Their response to people can range from friendly to quietly defensive. These Indigenous transport dogs of northeastern Asia carried people and cargo across sea ice and tundra; some also pull wheeled carts in summer.
VBO:0200363.shortDescription: Quick-learning Arctic transport dogs, valued for long-distance endurance and a response to people that varies.

sources.title: Russian Kynological Federation: Chukotka Sled Dog standard
sources.evidence: Published RKF2013/2015 standard describes quick learning and retained skills, long-distance endurance, reaction to people ranging from friendly to passively defensive, winter sea-ice/tundra transport and summer wheeled carts. Normative character/work account, not an empirical performance guarantee.
